summary: Refreshed current repo state before implementation. Branch is main tracking origin/main with only governance scaffolding dirty. Command contract is packageManager pnpm@11.2.0 with scripts evals, validate-contracts, check, test, and verify. Goal board validates. Implementation approval is present through the active native goal objective and repo-visible board; tracker mutation remains confirmation_required and out of scope.

Implemented PU-001 external project manifest contract with a recorded manifest path decision, closed JSON schema, semantic manifest owner, fixtures, and focused tests. Black-box execution remains vocabulary only and is blocked or human-approval-required; no target command execution path was added. Validation outcomes were pass for focused manifest tests, full pnpm test, smoke run, smoke check, and goal-board validation.

Reviewed PU-001 with simplify, improve-codebase-architecture, testing, and ubiquitous-language. One path-boundary finding was fixed before pass: Windows absolute paths and backslash traversal are now rejected by the manifest owner and covered by tests.

Implemented PU-002 authority classifier owner and schema-backed machine-readable action partitions. classifyAuthority derives authority_mode, proof_context, non_proof_claims, recovery_guidance, agent_next_actions, human_approval_required_actions, blocked_actions, runtime evidence status, black-box blocked status, and judge advisory boundary without running target commands. Validation outcomes were pass for focused classifier tests, combined manifest/classifier tests, full pnpm test, and smoke check.

Reviewed PU-002 with simplify, improve-codebase-architecture, testing, and ubiquitous-language. One duplicate-owner finding was fixed: the older manifest-level missing-manifest classifier was removed so authority-classifier.js is the single action partition owner.

Implemented PU-003 artifact-only external inspection output by wiring authority_classification into external check --repo-root and state --repo-root JSON output. The output is read-side only, marks missing target manifests as not_configured, keeps target_behavior_execution false, includes non-proof claims, and returns a human action for .evals/project.json without executing target code.

Reviewed PU-003 with simplify, improve-codebase-architecture, testing, and ubiquitous-language. One public-contract finding was fixed: check/state tests now validate nested authority_classification packets against the authorityClassification schema and validation-result.schema.json names the optional field.

Implemented PU-004 privacy approval evidence shape in the target-owned external project manifest. Privacy evidence now requires approval_status, scope, and data_classes; synthetic and public fixtures use explicit not_required evidence; authority classifier maps blocked and expired privacy approvals to blocked actions and pending approval to human_approval_required_actions without scanning target data or deciding approval.

Reviewed PU-004 with simplify, improve-codebase-architecture, testing, and ubiquitous-language. Privacy evidence remains target-owned: evals validates manifest evidence shape and partitions actions from approval_status, but does not scan private target data or make approval decisions.

Implemented PU-005 closeout by adding accepted ubiquitous-language terms, architecture map entries for the stable owner modules, clean implementation notes, and a local validation closeout artifact. Full validation passed across focused tests, pnpm test, smoke run, check, smoke check, state, and pnpm verify. The generated latest pointer was restored after validation because fresh run directories are ignored by repo policy.

Reviewed PU-005 and the full implementation with simplify, improve-codebase-architecture, testing, and ubiquitous-language. One low testing finding was fixed: blocked and expired privacy classifier tests now use the declared fixtures through manifest validation before classification. Focused and full tests passed after the fix.
